# Kinds and units

Every built-in kind, with its units, the products and quotients that have a
declared name, and the unit each built-in system stores it in. Each unit is on
`quantype.u` directly, as in `u.nm`, and in its kind's namespace, as in
`u.length.nanometer`. Dimensions are over quantype's base axes: length, energy, time, temperature, magnetic moment, atom, electron, charge.

## Kinds

| Kind | Dimensions | Units |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Dimensionless` | dimensionless | `one` (1), `dimensionless` |
| `Length` | length | `angstrom` (Å), `Angstrom`, `Ang`; `meter` (m), `m`, `metre`; `centimeter` (cm), `cm`; `nanometer` (nm), `nm`; `bohr` (a0); `millimeter` (mm), `mm`; `micrometer` (µm), `um`; `picometer` (pm), `pm` |
| `Area` | length² | `angstrom_squared` (Å^2), `angstrom2`; `square_meter` (m^2); `square_centimeter` (cm^2); `bohr_squared` (a0^2) |
| `Volume` | length³ | `angstrom_cubed` (Å^3), `angstrom3`; `cubic_meter` (m^3); `cubic_centimeter` (cm^3); `bohr_cubed` (a0^3) |
| `Time` | time | `femtosecond` (fs), `fs`; `picosecond` (ps), `ps`; `second` (s), `s`; `atomic_time` (ħ/Eh); `nanosecond` (ns), `ns`; `microsecond` (µs), `us`; `millisecond` (ms), `ms` |
| `Velocity` | length / time | `angstrom_per_fs` (Å/fs); `angstrom_per_ps` (Å/ps); `meter_per_second` (m/s); `centimeter_per_second` (cm/s); `atomic_velocity` (a0 Eh/ħ) |

## Named products and quotients

Each product also names the quotients that undo it. Any other product or quotient of two kinds is a product class from `quantype.products`, such as `LengthTime`; see [physical algebra](units.md#physical-algebra).

**Products**

- `Acceleration` × `Mass` = `Force`
- `Acceleration` × `Time` = `Velocity`
- `Action` × `InverseTime` = `Energy`
- `Area` × `ForceConstant` = `Energy`
- `Area` × `Length` = `Volume`
- `AtomCount` × `EnergyPerAtom` = `Energy`
- `Charge` × `ElectricField` = `Force`
- `Charge` × `ElectricPotential` = `Energy`
- `Charge` × `Length` = `DipoleMoment`
- `Dimensionless` × `Dimensionless` = `Dimensionless`
- `DipoleMoment` × `ElectricField` = `Energy`
- `ElectricField` × `Length` = `ElectricPotential`
- `ElectronDensity` × `Volume` = `ElectronCount`
- `Energy` × `Time` = `Action`
- `Entropy` × `TemperatureDifference` = `Energy`
- `Entropy` × `Temperature` = `Energy`
- `ForceConstant` × `Length` = `Force`
- `Force` × `Length` = `Energy`
- `Force` × `Time` = `Momentum`
- `Frequency` × `Time` = `Dimensionless`
- `InverseTime` × `Time` = `Dimensionless`
- `Length` × `Length` = `Area`
- `Magnetization` × `Volume` = `MagneticMoment`
- `MassDensity` × `Volume` = `Mass`
- `Mass` × `Velocity` = `Momentum`
- `Momentum` × `Velocity` = `Energy`
- `ParticleDensity` × `Volume` = `AtomCount`
- `Pressure` × `Volume` = `Energy`
- `TemperatureRate` × `Time` = `TemperatureDifference`
- `Time` × `Velocity` = `Length`

**Quotients**

- `Action` / `Energy` = `Time`
- `Action` / `Time` = `Energy`
- `Area` / `Length` = `Length`
- `AtomCount` / `ParticleDensity` = `Volume`
- `AtomCount` / `Volume` = `ParticleDensity`
- `DipoleMoment` / `Charge` = `Length`
- `DipoleMoment` / `Length` = `Charge`
- `ElectricPotential` / `ElectricField` = `Length`
- `ElectricPotential` / `Length` = `ElectricField`
- `ElectronCount` / `ElectronDensity` = `Volume`
- `ElectronCount` / `Volume` = `ElectronDensity`
- `Energy` / `Action` = `InverseTime`
- `Energy` / `Area` = `ForceConstant`
- `Energy` / `AtomCount` = `EnergyPerAtom`
- `Energy` / `Charge` = `ElectricPotential`
- `Energy` / `DipoleMoment` = `ElectricField`
- `Energy` / `ElectricField` = `DipoleMoment`
- `Energy` / `ElectricPotential` = `Charge`
- `Energy` / `EnergyPerAtom` = `AtomCount`
- `Energy` / `Entropy` = `Temperature`
- `Energy` / `Force` = `Length`
- `Energy` / `ForceConstant` = `Area`
- `Energy` / `InverseTime` = `Action`
- `Energy` / `Length` = `Force`
- `Energy` / `Momentum` = `Velocity`
- `Energy` / `Pressure` = `Volume`
- `Energy` / `Temperature` = `Entropy`
- `Energy` / `TemperatureDifference` = `Entropy`
- `Energy` / `Velocity` = `Momentum`
- `Energy` / `Volume` = `EnergyDensity`
- `Force` / `Acceleration` = `Mass`
- `Force` / `Area` = `Pressure`
- `Force` / `Charge` = `ElectricField`
- `Force` / `ElectricField` = `Charge`
- `Force` / `ForceConstant` = `Length`
- `Force` / `Length` = `ForceConstant`
- `Force` / `Mass` = `Acceleration`
- `Length` / `Time` = `Velocity`
- `Length` / `Velocity` = `Time`
- `MagneticMoment` / `Magnetization` = `Volume`
- `MagneticMoment` / `Volume` = `Magnetization`
- `Mass` / `MassDensity` = `Volume`
- `Mass` / `Volume` = `MassDensity`
- `Momentum` / `Force` = `Time`
- `Momentum` / `Mass` = `Velocity`
- `Momentum` / `Time` = `Force`
- `Momentum` / `Velocity` = `Mass`
- `TemperatureDifference` / `TemperatureRate` = `Time`
- `TemperatureDifference` / `Time` = `TemperatureRate`
- `Velocity` / `Acceleration` = `Time`
- `Velocity` / `Time` = `Acceleration`
- `Volume` / `Area` = `Length`
- `Volume` / `Length` = `Area`

## Units by system

`.value` is in these units, and `System.unit_for(Kind)` returns them. A star marks a unit the system sets directly instead of deriving it from its base units, as LAMMPS does for pressure. Arithmetic that produces or consumes those kinds rescales.

| Kind | `Atomistic` | `Metal` | `Real` | `SI` | `CGS` | `Atomic` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Dimensionless` | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| `Length` | Å | Å | Å | m | cm | a0 |
| `Area` | Å^2 | Å^2 | Å^2 | m^2 | cm^2 | a0^2 |
| `Volume` | Å^3 | Å^3 | Å^3 | m^3 | cm^3 | a0^3 |
| `Time` | fs | ps | fs | s | s | ħ/Eh |
| `Velocity` | Å/fs | Å/ps | Å/fs | m/s | cm/s | a0 Eh/ħ |
| `Energy` | eV | eV | kcal/mol | J | erg | Ha |
| `EnergyPerAtom` | eV/atom | eV/atom | kcal/mol/atom | J/atom | erg/atom | Ha/atom |
| `Force` | eV/Å | eV/Å | kcal/mol/Å | N | dyn | Ha/a0 |
| `ForceConstant` | eV/Å^2 | eV/Å^2 | kcal/mol/Å^2 | N/m | dyn/cm | Ha/a0^2 |
| `Pressure` | eV/Å^3 | bar* | atm* | Pa | Ba | Ha/a0^3 |
| `EnergyDensity` | eV/Å^3 | eV/Å^3 | kcal/mol/Å^3 | J/m^3 | erg/cm^3 | Ha/a0^3 |
| `EnergyPerVolume` | eV/Å^3 | eV/Å^3 | kcal/mol/Å^3 | J/m^3 | erg/cm^3 | Ha/a0^3 |
| `Temperature` | K | K | K | K | K | K |
| `TemperatureDifference` | ΔK | ΔK | ΔK | ΔK | ΔK | ΔK |
| `TemperatureRate` | K/fs | K/ps | K/fs | K/s | K/s | K Eh/ħ |
| `MagneticMoment` | μB | μB | μB | A m^2 | erg/G | eħ/me |
| `Magnetization` | μB/Å^3 | μB/Å^3 | μB/Å^3 | A/m | emu/cm^3 | eħ/me/a0^3 |
| `ParticleDensity` | atom/Å^3 | atom/Å^3 | atom/Å^3 | atom/m^3 | atom/cm^3 | atom/a0^3 |
| `ElectronDensity` | electron/Å^3 | electron/Å^3 | electron/Å^3 | electron/m^3 | electron/cm^3 | electron/a0^3 |
| `Angle` | rad | rad | rad | rad | rad | rad |
| `Frequency` | fs^-1 | THz | fs^-1 | Hz | Hz | Eh/ħ |
| `InverseTime` | fs^-1 | ps^-1 | fs^-1 | s^-1 | s^-1 | Eh/ħ |
| `AtomCount` | atom | atom | atom | atom | atom | atom |
| `ElectronCount` | electron | electron | electron | electron | electron | electron |
| `Mass` | Da* | g/mol* | g/mol* | kg | g | m_e |
| `MassDensity` | g/cm^3* | g/cm^3* | g/cm^3* | kg/m^3 | g/cm^3 | m_e/a0^3 |
| `Momentum` | eV fs/Å | eV ps/Å | kcal/mol fs/Å | kg m/s | g cm/s | ħ/a0 |
| `Acceleration` | Å/fs^2 | Å/ps^2 | Å/fs^2 | m/s^2 | cm/s^2 | a0 Eh^2/ħ^2 |
| `Charge` | e | e | e | C | statC | e |
| `ElectricPotential` | V | V | kcal/mol/e | V | statV | Ha/e |
| `ElectricField` | V/Å | V/Å | V/Å* | V/m | statV/cm | Ha/(e a0) |
| `DipoleMoment` | e Å | e Å | e Å | C m | statC cm | e a0 |
| `Entropy` | eV/K | eV/K | kcal/mol/K | J/K | erg/K | Ha/K |
